**Comparison of COGS growth (FY 2022 → FY 2023)**  

| Company | FY 2022 COGS | FY 2023 COGS | % change | Source |
|---------|--------------|--------------|----------|--------|
| Lululemon | **$328.6 M** USD | **$429.7 M** USD | **+30.8 %** | Lululemon 2023 Annual Report (consolidated statement of operations) |
| Aritzia | **$1,096.2 M** CAD | **$1,281.6 M** CAD | **+16.9 %** | Aritzia 2023 Annual Report (consolidated statement of operations) |

**Calculation overview**

- **Lululemon**:  
  \[
  \frac{429.7-328.6}{328.6}\times100\% \approx 30.8\%
  \]
- **Aritzia**:  
  \[
  \frac{1{,}281.6-1{,}096.2}{1{,}096.2}\times100\% \approx 16.9\%
  \]

**Result**

Lululemon’s cost of goods sold grew by **about 31 %** from fiscal 2022 to fiscal 2023, whereas Aritzia’s grew by **about 17 %** over the same period. Therefore, **Lululemon had the larger percentage change in COGS**.
